releases.notes:
This is a minor update to ForceDisableEasterEggs, and disables the following easter eggs:

- Disqualification of `This message will never appear on the splash screen, isn't that weird?` splash text
- Unobtainable, Halloween-only pumpkins and jack-o-lanterns on the heads of zombies
- Splash texts in crash logs ("witty comments")
- Splash texts in profile results

This version was compiled against Minecraft 1.20.1 and Quilt Loader 0.21.2, and was successfully tested against versions 1.20.2 and 1.20.4, and fabric loader, too.

releases.notes:
This is a major update to ForceDisableEasterEggs, and disables the following easter eggs:

- `<USERNAME> IS YOU` splash text
- Pirate speak trigger from recipe book
- Visual flipping of entities named `Grumm` and `Dinnerbone`
- `Deadmau5`-specific ears and name tag placement
- Evokers changing the color of blue sheep to red
- "Minceraft" logo on title screen
- Animated rainbow color for sheep wool
- `missingno` as an error message in item tooltips

This version was compiled against Minecraft 1.20.1 and Quilt Loader 0.21.2, and was successfully tested against versions 1.20.2 and 1.20.4, and fabric loader, too.

releases.notes:
This is the first public version of ForceDisableEasterEggs, and disables the following easter eggs:

- Christmas splash text
- Chest retexturing for christmas
- Halloween splash text
- New year splash text

This version was compiled against Minecraft 1.20.1 and Quilt Loader 0.21.2, and was successfully tested against versions 1.20.2 and 1.20.4, and fabric loader, too.

readmeSummary: This is a Minecraft mod for Quilt (/Fabric) to disable easter eggs that do not have an explicit option or setting to disable them. Designed for Quilt 1.20.1, works in 1.20.2 and 1.20.4.
